name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with racing simulations. He spent countless hours tweaking setups and analyzing telemetry, eventually leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he gained experience in smaller racing teams, honing his skills in data analysis and simulator development. Alistair is known for his ability to translate real-world track conditions into accurate and immersive simulator experiences, helping drivers refine their techniques and optimize car setups. His big-picture thinking and innovative approach make him a valuable asset to Herberth Motorsport.

He is dedicated to ensuring that drivers can effectively use the simulator to improve their performance. While he enjoys collaborating with the team, Alistair is also comfortable working independently, often diving deep into the technical aspects of the simulator to identify and address potential issues. His creative solutions and meticulous attention to detail set him apart.
